title: Lock, keycard
summary: An electronic lock keyed to open with keycards. Without one of the normal ways of accessing the lock, a creature proficient with hacker's kits can pick this lock with a successful DC 15 Intellligence check. Better…
markdown: An electronic lock keyed to open with keycards. Without one of the normal ways of accessing the lock, a creature proficient with hacker's kits can pick this lock with a successful DC 15 Intellligence check. Better locks are available at higher prices.
